messages.body: Ledger plan: your ruling says to record the brief templates as verbatim copies of the S1 review briefs with only the command substitution. The S1 brief texts (T05-T09) live outside this worktree (the experiment folders), which my rules say not to touch, and my SPEC gives no path for them. Which should the plan do? (A) You give me the exact repo-relative or absolute path of the three S1 review briefs, and the plan's brief task copies them read-only into .dev/brainstorms/346-ledger/briefs/ with only the substitution. (B) The plan writes only the substitution line plus copy instructions, and the coordinator supplies the brief files at implement time. Recommendation: A, if you can give the path now.
